A PhD position is currently open at IMT Atlantique, Nantes Campus, and I would be grateful for your help in sharing this opportunity with potential candidates.

The PhD focuses on learning user-defined constraints from data by combining Machine Learning and Constraint Programming. It is part of the ANR-funded

and includes a real-world application developed in collaboration with IMADIS Group in the field of emergency teleradiology.

The successful candidate will join a stimulating research environment at IMT Atlantique and the LS2N laboratory and will have the opportunity to collaborate with the academic and industrial partners involved in the FIDD project.

Further details about the research topic, candidate profile, and application procedure are provided in the attached document.

Interested candidates are welcome to contact Nicolas Beldiceanu or me for further information.
